$comment: Tachles follows official stable Hermes. This is a minimum capability baseline, never an upper version ceiling or an engine pin.

releaseChannel.note: Resolve the newest published stable SemVer release. Exclude historical CalVer tags, drafts and prereleases. Never fall back silently to an older release.
releaseChannel.installerContract: Verify the official scripts/install.ps1 blob at the resolved release tag, then invoke it with -Tag. Hermes owns its runtime, dependencies and updates. Community provisioning only adds profiles, configuration and skills.

trustAndUpdateProcess: New official stable releases remain eligible without changing Tachles. Runtime capability checks guard actual interface drift. Before a Tachles release, verify the plugin SDK, guarded outbound surfaces, and Makom end-to-end against the newest official stable Hermes, then refresh the verified version and evidence.
